nom: TONYMOLY I’m Pearl Luminating Sheet Mask

avis.titre: Arrived as expected + something to note about possible "fakes"
avis.texte: Arrived quickly and exactly how I expected based on the product description. I received two that said "I"m Real" and the rest said "I'm (Insert Additive)". I saw another review say that they might be fake because some of them say "I'm Real" and some say "I'm Rice" or whatever the special additive is. I looked around on the TonyMoly website (both US and Korean) and determined that this doesn't necessarily mean they're fake. Some of their hand lotions from the same line (on TonyMoly's own website) say "I'm Rice" or "I'm Ginseng" or whatever. Not saying this means that those masks are for sure not fakes, but that this difference isn't necessarily a reason not to buy. Also 99% of the Korean on the back of both "versions" say the same thing, with only minor differences in placement of the actual text. I've used these masks for years and love them, mostly for the relaxation/self-care aspect. Can't necessarily speak of any long term difference in my skin, but at least for a day or two after it feels more hydrated and healthier.
Only brand of face masks I love! They do exactly what they are suppose to do. Relaxing and skin feels great after use. Long lasting effects.
I love these face masks! They smell so good and they are great for your skin! I have nothing but good things to say about them but I wish I could buy more

Holy MOLY lol...these masks are incredibly wonderful!! The quality is excellent, the ingredients are superb...I used the lavender one last night, and my face felt so hydrated and plump after! I usually only use Avatara masks bc they are very high quality too, but I will probably start using these a lot more, because the quality is there but for a lower price than Avatara. The ONLY thing that makes me sad is that I didn't receive the Cactus mask, and this pack was supposed to have cactus in it. I was really looking forward to that one but got Hemp instead. But I'm not too worried about it, because like I said, the quality is wonderful. There was absolutely no irritation afterwards.

These are really nice and effective made my skin feel nice and clean and I didn’t have any problems I can’t normally wear a lot of face masks because my skin is sensitive and breaks out with highly scented chemicals, but lucky this is a good brand and doesn’t cause any skin irritations.

I ordered these for a teen girls skills training group (mindfulness and self care) and they were a hit. Good quality sheet masks and everyone loved picking a different kind. They were very moisturizing and no adverse reactions to the ingredients.
La verdad ame cada mascarilla que venia en este paquete. Quisiera que estuviera disponible otra vez para pedirlo
La mascarilla llego rota y el suero se rego por todo el empaque :(

Su paquetería entrega paquetes sin cerciorarse de que son las personas correctas. Quisiera poner una calificación de estrella apropiada, pero nisiquiera probé las mascarillas, mal sabor de boca con este artículo, dudo volver a pedir algo de esta marca.

My favorite masks. I’ve been using them for several years. My favorites are red wine, avocado, and pomegranate (pomegranate isn’t in this set, but it’s part of the same line). My skin always feels well hydrated after using them, and no cream has replaced them so far.
I have very sensitive skin and these work wonders for me!! highly recommend 😌 always leave my skin feeling fresh and so much softer. and the packaging is so cute always 🫶🏻
I love that I get to sample multiple at a reasonable price! I have been a fan of tonymoly products and have been trying the I'm real face masks. This is perfect to find which works best for me.

I did not receive all of the items shown. My order came in a plastic bag without rose, rice, and peach. Instead, it looks like they were replaced with coffee, pumpkin, and pomegranate. I only noticed after putting on the coffee mask, when I went to research its ingredients on Amazon and couldn't find the mask listed. Be careful if you have any allergies, you might not get what you ordered. I'm giving three stars because I love the quality of these masks.

I love to save money and this would've been an amazing deal but the package came punctured inside the envelope and the mask on top leaked everywhere and is unusable. The one behind it barely made it but is not damaged. Overall, I'd rather go to an Ulta and pick it up myself to ensure I'll get the most use for my money next time.

I’m pretty satisfied with the order but the cover photo is a little inaccurate. I wasn’t expecting the Makgeolli or Cactus mask. The cover photo shows a lily mask and another one that wasn’t cactus. I’m not extremely mad because I’ve used this brand before and I’m mostly satisfied with all of their mask just confused as to why two of the mask marketed were not the same.

avis.titre: Should of listened to the other review - expired products
avis.texte: Three were expired and three had no expiration date. That leaves me four out of ten that are good to use. Not impressed, do not buy
